$comment: Phase-1 economy table. Values approved per docs/08-economy-balance.md (2026-11-22): pacing targets P1-P4, overflow = clamp + StockpileFull event, XP continues while stockpile is full. Rates are whole units per second (independent of tick rate); the sim converts to per-tick Q32.32 fixed-point once at load (DR-0003, TICKS_PER_SECOND=60). 'capacity' is in whole units. A role with no 'produces' consumes nothing and produces nothing in Phase 1.
